# GlobiGuard Open

GlobiGuard is an AI governance platform. It intercepts, authorizes, and audits
AI agent actions before they execute — blocking dangerous actions, queuing
high-risk decisions for human approval, and logging every outcome as tamper-evident evidence.

## MCP Server (AI agent integration)

Package: @globiguard/mcp-server
Install: npx -y @globiguard/mcp-server authority
MCP schema: https://github.com/globiguard/globiguard-open/blob/main/packages/mcp-server/server.json

The MCP server exposes a governance authority to any MCP-capable AI agent
(Claude, Cursor, Windsurf, Cline, etc). Agents call `globiguard_govern_action`
before executing high-risk operations. The server returns ALLOW, BLOCK, MODIFY,
or QUEUE decisions based on active policies.

### MCP configuration (Claude Desktop / Cursor / Windsurf)

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "globiguard": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": ["-y", "@globiguard/mcp-server", "authority"],
      "env": {
        "GLOBIGUARD_PROJECT_ID": "project_...",
        "GLOBIGUARD_SECRET_KEY": "ggsk_...",
        "GLOBIGUARD_ENVIRONMENT": "sandbox"
      }
    }
  }
}
```

### MCP tools

- `globiguard_govern_action` — authorize an action before execution
- `globiguard_get_authorization` — retrieve a specific authorization decision
- `globiguard_check_approval` — poll for human approval on a queued decision
- `globiguard_get_evidence` — fetch tamper-evident audit evidence
- `globiguard_get_audit_event` — inspect a specific audit event
- `globiguard_list_active_policies` — list policies in force
- `globiguard_get_policy` — retrieve a specific policy

Active policies are also available as `globiguard://policies/{policyId}` MCP resources.

### Governed tool gateway

The MCP server can also act as a governed proxy for any other MCP server.
Wrap any tool (GitHub, Slack, databases) with GlobiGuard governance — the
downstream tool call only executes after an ALLOW decision.

## SDK packages

- `@globiguard/sdk` — TypeScript/Node.js server SDK
- `@globiguard/react` — React hooks and UI components
- `@globiguard/realtime` — WebSocket subscription client
- `@globiguard/contracts` — shared types and contracts
- `n8n-nodes-globiguard` — n8n workflow automation nodes

## Other language SDKs

- Python: globiguard (PyPI)
- Go: github.com/globiguard/globiguard-go
- Java: com.globiguard:globiguard (Maven Central)
- .NET: GlobiGuard (NuGet)
- PHP: globiguard/globiguard (Packagist)
- Ruby: globiguard (RubyGems)
